originality.rationale: The original first-public June 15 2023 harmonic resetting-Brownian-drive paper gives the model, single-time position moments, position density, ordinary position autocorrelation and a single-coordinate dynamical renewal. The evaluated all-positive-lag comparison between forward and reverse squared-observable cross-covariances and the exact sharp maximum of the normalized integrated difference are not stated there. The more general cross-correlation entropy bounds of Gu neither evaluate these functions nor imply the displayed optimum by direct specialization. Related reset-driven inertial transport differs at the level of generator and observables. Broad generic generator closures could implicitly cover calculations, leaving explicit priority risk despite the checked distinctions.

value.rationale: Harmonic trapping under non-Gaussian reset Brownian forcing is a motivated nonequilibrium transport model. The physically natural squared position and drive observables diagnose directional predictive coupling invisible in the cited ordinary single-coordinate correlations. A strict all-lag sign and sharp finite reset-to-relaxation rate maximizing normalized integrated directionality give a useful exact phase/optimization boundary, not an arbitrary parameter slice or routine rewriting.
